name: @hackbuild/vision
description: Perception through the models hub: depth (Depth Anything V2 small), detection (MediaPipe EfficientDet, YOLO as an optional external model), segmentation, face, hand and pose landmarks with a fallback chain, captions and questions through small VLMs, a webcam loop helper and a result cache.
author: Moheeb Zara <hackbuildvideo@gmail.com>
